bcss_01.observation: All22 overview masks inspected against H&E, reference, coarse and RGB. Red gland masses, grey upper necrosis and thin green separations are not fully recovered. J01/M04/K05 and most field children create false gold outlines at red-green interfaces; C17 and N08 largely suppress those outlines, N13 instead creates grey fringes. N03 is stepped. Glass children have little visible effect on the central problem; tiny violet reference area remains unresolved.

N01/K05/N07/N08/N09 modestly change the fine green network without restoring the annotated topology. N03 adds block steps. Glass variants look near the parent in this dense field.
